label: The road
value: Jeep-able link road from Utror to the Loypanrghalay valley; the lake is a trek from there
quote: A small jeep-able link road from Utror leads part of the way to the lake, ending in a valley called Loypanrghalay

label: Trek time, two sources
value: 3 to 6 hours from Loypanghalay (Wikipedia); almost 2 hours (Dunya News, updated Aug 2019)
quote: The lake can be accessed from here after trekking for almost 3–6 hours.
source: Wikipedia, Izmis Lake (undated); Dunya News, updated 1 Aug 2019

label: Trek time, Dunya News
value: Almost 2 hours trek from the Loypanghalay end of the road
quote: The lake can be accessed from here after trekking for almost two hours.

label: Season
value: Summer; grazers from the plains use the pastures then
quote: attract several grazers from the plains in summer.

label: Road condition (2013)
value: A 2013 trip report says the jeep track reached only a couple of km past Utror, with a broken bridge; check locally
quote: these days only a couple of km ahead of Utror
source: PakWheels trip report, June 2013 (Kundol trek, same Utror road)

label: Setting
value: South-west of Utror valley, at a high altitude above the treeline (Wikipedia)
quote: located to the south-west of Utror valley at a high altitude above the treeline
